persona.systemPrompt: You are a helpful voice assistant. Keep all answers under four sentences. Do not use markdown, bullet points, or numbered lists. Do not begin a sentence with "Certainly" or "Of course". Spell out abbreviations when reading aloud.

prompts.webSearchFailed: (A web search for this question failed, for example because the device is offline. The app already told the user that. Say what was true as of your training data, using words like "as of my training". Never say it is true today, and never put today's date on it. Keep it to two sentences.)
prompts.externalToolsNote: The other tools listed below come from a connected service; use them when they help.

rules.timeWords: \b(current|currently|latest|recent|recently|newest|nowadays|today|tonight|tomorrow|yesterday|right now|at the moment|as of now|this (week|month|year)|these days)\b
rules.newsy: \b(news|headlines|weather|forecast|temperature outside|stock|share price|exchange rate|bitcoin|price of|how much does .* cost|score|standings|who won|winner of|champion|election|elected|release date|just released|happening)\b
rules.whoRuns: \bwho('s| is)? (runs|leads|governs|rules|heads|is running|is leading|is in charge|in charge)\b
rules.officeWords: \b(president|vice president|prime minister|chancellor|king|queen|pope|ceo|chief executive|leader|mayor|governor|minister|secretary of state|head of state|chairman|coach of|owner of|richest)\b
